abstract_sentences.text: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) methods enhance LLM performance by efficiently filtering relevant context for LLMs, reducing hallucinations and inference cost.
However, most existing RAG methods focus on single-step retrieval, which is often insufficient for answering complex questions that require multi-step search.
Recently, multi-step retrieval approaches have emerged, typically involving the fine-tuning of small LLMs to perform multi-step retrieval.
This type of fine-tuning is highly resource-intensive and does not enable the use of larger LLMs.
In this work, we propose Q-RAG, a novel approach that fine-tunes the Embedder model for multi-step retrieval using reinforcement learning (RL).

Q-RAG offers a competitive, resource-efficient alternative to existing multi-step retrieval methods for open-domain question answering and achieves state-of-the-art results on the popular long-context benchmarks BabiLong and RULER for contexts up to 10M tokens.

final_judgment.single_storyline: Q-RAG 将 multi-step retrieval 的策略学习从 LLM query generation 移到 value-based state/action embedder；RL 更新 embedder，dot-product Q 评分候选，relative position 为 narrative temporal search 提供状态相关坐标，冻结 LLM 只接收选中 chunks。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: MDP 与 support-fact reward、soft Q/target/λ-return、relative positional mapping、BabiLong/RULER/HotPotQA/MuSiQue 主结果、组件消融、retrieval budget 与 baseline 来源标签。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 表达能力和收敛 proof、L∞ 边界、early stopping ROC、Plan Q-RAG、复杂度、训练曲线、extra QA、hyperparameters、模型/分块配置及 Fact EM 定义被移入 Appendix A–G。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 先固定 state/action/environment 数据流，Eq. (1)–(7) 随后引入训练对象；Table 3 在同一长度轴上并列删除 RL、target 和 soft-Q；Appendix B 将 stop 错误拆成三类并与 ROC 对齐。
final_judgment.largest_gap: relative temporal mechanism 没有独立 ablation；10M claim 主要依赖折线图与异源 baseline；reported、reproduced、oracle hop-count 设置不完全同质；主文缺少完整 seed、分母、uncertainty 与独立 limitations 节。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 长上下文系统应把检索状态如何形成、context length 如何变化、结果以什么分母比较、失败和计算代价放在同一条证据链，并为每个新增机制配置隔离对照或可证伪预测。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合有检索轨迹和 context-scaling 轴的系统论文；纯生成或定性案例工作需要改用答案生成误差、轨迹可观测性和任务级分母。
